title: Alice In Wonderland — repeated MusicalMoment relation candidates

source_scope.evidence_type: three literature-aligned micro-sequences from one recording

observed_transition: bass enters active ascending eighth-note foreground
bass returns to longer-value lower-register support
bass matches rhythmic/contour shape while piano repeats it
bass echoes resolution one beat later
piano sixteenth-dominant foreground with conservative low-register bass
piano changes subdivision to short ascending eighth-note phrase
bass activity increases with ascending eighth-note contour
bass phrase resolves on beat one of bar 47

recurrent_observations.statement: Across all three windows, a comparatively conservative/supporting bass state is followed by increased bass phrase activity near a salient change or boundary in the piano foreground.
recurrent_observations.does_not_claim: The piano event caused the bass change.

recurrent_observations.statement: In bars 37-39 and 45-47, the bass changes from simpler support toward material that shares rhythmic and/or contour characteristics with the immediately surrounding piano phrase.
recurrent_observations.does_not_claim: LaFaro consciously copied Evans because of a detected trigger.

recurrent_observations.statement: In bars 13-18 and 37-39, a temporary increase in bass foreground activity is followed by a return to simpler supporting behavior.
recurrent_observations.does_not_claim: All LaFaro foreground phrases must return immediately to support.

legend_hypotheses.hypothesis: LaFaro may treat foreground/support role as rapidly switchable at phrase-level ensemble boundaries rather than as a chorus-level fixed role.
evidence_needed: repeat in another verified LaFaro recording/tune

legend_hypotheses.hypothesis: LaFaro may respond to nearby piano rhythmic/contour shapes by preserving relational shape while re-realizing pitches for his own line.
evidence_needed: separate examples where piano changes but bass does not respond
negative-control comparison to avoid confirmation bias

negative_controls_required: windows where Evans changes subdivision but LaFaro remains conservative
windows where LaFaro becomes active without a preceding Evans gap/subdivision change
windows where LaFaro remains active while Evans re-enters
examples from Nardis / Waltz For Debby / another bassist for comparison
promotion_rule: Do not convert these same-recording relation candidates directly into Shared Grammar or a strong Legend prior. Cross-recording evidence and negative controls are required.
